features.name: Martial Flexibility
features.summary: Spend a daily use to gain a combat feat temporarily; higher levels allow more simultaneous feats.
features.uses: 3 + half Brawler level uses per day

features.name: Martial Training
features.summary: Count Brawler levels as Fighter and Monk levels for feat prerequisites and effects.

features.name: Unarmed Strike
features.summary: Gain Improved Unarmed Strike and Monk unarmed damage using Brawler level.

features.name: Brawler's Flurry
features.summary: Make a two-weapon-style full attack with close weapons or weapons from the close fighter group.

features.name: Maneuver Training
features.summary: Gain +1 on checks and CMD with a chosen combat maneuver.

features.name: AC Bonus
features.summary: Gain +1 dodge AC in light or no armour; improves every 4 levels.

features.name: Knockout
features.summary: Once per day, declare an unarmed hit that can render the target unconscious; gain additional uses at levels 10 and 16.
features.uses: 1 use per day; +1 at levels 10 and 16

features.name: Close Weapon Mastery
features.summary: Use Brawler unarmed damage with close weapons, subject to weapon-size limits.

features.name: Improved Martial Flexibility
features.summary: Gain two combat feats with one use; one may satisfy the other's prerequisites.

features.name: Awesome Blow
features.summary: Gain the Awesome Blow combat feat even without meeting its prerequisites.

features.name: Greater Martial Flexibility
features.summary: Gain three combat feats with one use, building prerequisite chains among them.

features.name: Improved Awesome Blow
features.summary: Use Awesome Blow as an attack rather than a standard action and add weapon damage.

features.name: Awesome Blow Mastery
features.summary: Use Awesome Blow against creatures of any size and improve its distance and impact.
